mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a 'higher for longer' monetary policy response to persistent inflation, which increases uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.5% over the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240), the Federal Reserve's response to inflationary pressures typically leads to a prolonged tightening cycle, which suppresses equity valuations and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 240, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in new housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing and a contracting real estate sector, which reduces overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in new housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in the housing sector, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% over the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% over the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
